      Returning Seller Fulfilled Items

      The return timelines for seller-fulfilled items sold on Amazon.in are equivalent to the return timelines mentioned above for items fulfilled by Amazon.

      If you’ve received a seller-fulfilled product in a condition that is damaged, defective or different from its description on the product detail page on Amazon.in, returns are subject to the seller's approval of the return.

      If you do not receive a response from the seller for your return request within two business days, you can submit an A-to-Z Guarantee claim. Learn more about returning seller fulfilled items.

      Note: For seller fulfilled items from Books, Movies & TV Shows categories, the sellers need to be informed of the damage/ defect within 14 days of delivery.

      For seller-fulfilled items from Fine Art category, the sellers need to be informed of the damage / defect within 10 days of delivery. These items are not eligible for self-return. The seller will arrange the return pick up for these items.

      For seller-fulfilled items from Sports collectibles and Entertainment collectibles categories, the sellers need to be informed of the damage / defect within 10 days of delivery.
      Returning Global Store Items

      The General Return Policy is applicable for all Amazon Global Store Products (“Product”). If the Product is eligible for a refund on return, you can choose to return the Product either through courier Pickup or Self-Return**

      Note: - Once the package is received at Amazon Export Sales LLC fulfillment center in the US, it takes 2 (two) business days for the refund to be processed and 2- 4 business days for the refund amount to reflect in your account. - If your return is due to an Amazon error you'll receive a full refund, else the shipping charges (onward & return) along with import fees will be deducted from your refund amount.

      **For products worth more than INR 25000, we only offer Self-Return option.
      Returning Products with Inspect & Buy label

      2 Days, Refund

      Refunds are applicable only if determined that the item was not damaged while in your possession, or is not different from what was shipped to you.

      About this item

      • 5G Connectivity for Faster Performance: Experience lightning-fast 5G speeds for seamless streaming, gaming, and browsing without lag.
      • 6.72” 120Hz IPS LCD Display: Enjoy a smooth and immersive visual experience with HDR10 support and 1000 nits peak brightness.
      • 50MP AI Dual Camera System: Capture sharp, detailed images with a 50MP primary sensor and 8MP ultra-wide lens for stunning landscapes and group shots.
      • 16MP Selfie Camera with HDR: Take crystal-clear selfies and record high-quality 1080p videos for social media and video calls.
      • Powerful Unisoc T760 (6nm) Processor: Delivers efficient performance for multitasking, gaming, and everyday use with smooth responsiveness.
      • 4GB RAM + 128GB Storage with Expandable Memory: Enjoy lag-free performance and store more photos, videos, and apps with a dedicated microSDXC slot.
      • Massive 5000mAh Battery & 18W Fast Charging: Stay powered throughout the day with all-day battery life and quick recharging capability.
      • Side-Mounted Fingerprint Sensor: Unlock your phone instantly and securely with the fast and accurate side fingerprint scanner.
      • Stereo Speakers with 3.5mm Audio Jack: Enjoy clear, immersive sound quality with high-fidelity stereo speakers and wired headphone support.
      • Android 14 with a Clean UI: Experience the latest Android OS with smooth performance, security updates, and an optimized user experience.

      Product description

      The Motorola G35 5G in Midnight Black, with 4GB of RAM and 128GB of internal storage, is a budget-friendly 5G smartphone that provides a smooth, modern Android experience. Key features include a 120Hz Full HD+ display, a dual-camera system with a 50MP main sensor, a large 5000mAh battery, and a water-repellent design. Key specifications Display: 6.72-inch Full HD+ (2400 x 1080) LTPS LCD display with a 120Hz refresh rate, 1,000 nits peak brightness, and Corning Gorilla Glass 3 protection. Processor: Unisoc T760 octa-core processor (6nm) with a clock speed of up to 2.2 GHz. Memory and storage: 4GB of LPDDR4x RAM (with RAM Boost technology for up to 12GB virtual memory) and 128GB of UFS 2.2 internal storage. Storage is expandable up to 1TB via a hybrid microSD card slot. Rear cameras: Dual-camera system: 50MP main camera with f/1.8 aperture, Quad Pixel technology, and PDAF. 8MP ultrawide + macro camera with a 120.2° field of view and fixed focus. Front camera: 16MP selfie camera with f/2.4 aperture. Battery and charging: A 5000mAh battery supporting 18W TurboPower wired fast charging, with an 18W or 20W charger included in the box. Design: The Midnight Black color features a 3D PMMA (plastic) finish, while other colors may offer vegan leather. It has a lightweight build and an IP52 water-repellent rating. Operating system: Ships with Motorola's Hello UI based on Android 14. It is expected to receive one major OS update to Android 15 and two years of security patches. Audio: Dual stereo speakers with Dolby Atmos support and a 3.5mm headset jack. Connectivity: Supports 12 5G bands, Wi-Fi 5 (802.11 ac), Bluetooth 5.0, NFC (market dependent), and USB Type-C 2.0. Security: Side-mounted fingerprint reader and face unlock.

        Reviewed in India on 10 November 2025
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        (4.5/5) Great Daily Use 5G Phone for the Price!

        I’ve been using the Motorola G35 5G for a while now, and overall, it’s a really solid phone for its price range (around ₹9,500). This phone isn’t built for heavy gaming or performance enthusiasts, but for daily use, it works perfectly fine.

        Performance & Usage:

        For calls, social media, streaming, and regular multitasking, the phone performs smoothly. It runs clean stock Android, which makes the experience simple and ad-free. However, I did notice some lag when using a third-party launcher, which seems like a small software issue. Apart from that, it performs very well for normal use.

        Battery Life:

        The battery backup is decent, giving around 5 to 6 hours of screen-on time with light to moderate use. Charging speed is average, but once charged, it easily lasts a full day for normal users.

        Camera:

        The 50MP main camera takes good shots in daylight — sharp and detailed for this price point. The 8MP macro camera isn’t very useful, but the 16MP front camera is surprisingly good. Selfies come out clear and natural, which is a nice touch for a budget phone.

        Build & Design:

        The phone feels good in hand, lightweight yet sturdy. The design looks clean and simple, which I personally prefer.

        Verdict:

        At around ₹9.5K, the Moto G35 5G is a great value-for-money daily use smartphone. It offers a clean software experience, good display, reliable battery, and decent cameras. It’s not made for gaming or very heavy tasks, but for regular everyday use, it’s an excellent option.

        Rating: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4.5/5)

        A well-balanced phone that does what it promises — smooth daily performance, decent battery, and clean Android at an affordable price.

      About this Item

      • 5G Connectivity for Faster Performance: Experience lightning-fast 5G speeds for seamless streaming, gaming, and browsing without lag.
      • 6.72” 120Hz IPS LCD Display: Enjoy a smooth and immersive visual experience with HDR10 support and 1000 nits peak brightness.
      • 50MP AI Dual Camera System: Capture sharp, detailed images with a 50MP primary sensor and 8MP ultra-wide lens for stunning landscapes and group shots.
      • 16MP Selfie Camera with HDR: Take crystal-clear selfies and record high-quality 1080p videos for social media and video calls.
      • Powerful Unisoc T760 (6nm) Processor: Delivers efficient performance for multitasking, gaming, and everyday use with smooth responsiveness.
      • 4GB RAM + 128GB Storage with Expandable Memory: Enjoy lag-free performance and store more photos, videos, and apps with a dedicated microSDXC slot.
      • Massive 5000mAh Battery & 18W Fast Charging: Stay powered throughout the day with all-day battery life and quick recharging capability.
      • Side-Mounted Fingerprint Sensor: Unlock your phone instantly and securely with the fast and accurate side fingerprint scanner.
      • Stereo Speakers with 3.5mm Audio Jack: Enjoy clear, immersive sound quality with high-fidelity stereo speakers and wired headphone support.
      • Android 14 with a Clean UI: Experience the latest Android OS with smooth performance, security updates, and an optimized user experience.
